verdict.rationale: Llama is primarily an open-weights model family, so a built-in assistant is not its core surface. Still, llama.com advertises "Multi-agent coding in your terminal," and a community user describes delegating queries through the Meta Chat UI, which is fast and cites sources. Both are glancing mentions with no documentation of how tasks are delegated, and the chat UI is geofenced in some countries. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing an in-product assistant and its task-delegation workflow, details of the terminal multi-agent tool, hands-on corroboration of agentic task completion, and broad availability.
